status: Pesquisa exploratória. Não é certificação de exatidão ou calibração de chance de vitória. Estimador principal preservado.

baseline.reference: engine.js estimate() original, municipal observation sharing versus global shift

experiments.type: Four preserved actual 2022 second-round municipal partial snapshots, first-round baseline, final domestic official share as target
experiments.warning: Challenger selected after observing historical 2022 final results; replay is exploratory, not independent holdout.

experiments.type: 960 deterministic synthetic whole-municipality arrival paths across 2014/2018 balanced/regional scenarios at approx 5%, 10% and 25% of first-round valid votes
experiments.warning: Full-city samples do not test prediction quality for partly-counted municipalities.

experiments.type: 600 simulated paths selecting approx independent sections from municipalities, varying within-municipality preference by sigma 2% and 8%
experiments.warning: Unrealistically broad early geographic coverage: ~2,760–3,800 municipalities already sampled around 5% versus 1,434 in preserved 2022 6.5% vote snapshot. Do not treat this as external validation.

experiments.type: Use actual 2022 snapshot set of municipality IDs and sectionsPct-by-city to partially reveal 2014/2018 votes, with synthetic within-city preference noise sigma 3 or 8 percentage points
experiments.warning: Historic 2022 city arrival patterns are real, but 2014/2018 intra-city partials are artificial and no actual 2014/18 reporting times are available.

experiments.type: 384 stage x sigma x year simulations with 2022 real city reporting coverage, 2014 and 2018 final votes, sigma 3 or 8 pp and 24 seeds per stage
experiments.warning: Weights selected after multiple experiments, apparent improvement has optimization bias.

experiments.type: 880 new synthetic paths with same 2022 partial-municipality coverage pattern and sigma 3 or 8 pp
experiments.warning: New random seeds are not independent historical elections. Challenger still worsens specific earliest 2018 stage; not safe to promote as default solely from this.

liveProbabilityFix.symptom: Under unchanged Flavio official share of 53%, previously the early scenario chance rose solely with sectionsPct (5%=>23.23%;10%=>38.57%;15%=>52.23%;20%=>63.25%), even with no usable geography.
liveProbabilityFix.fix: Removed square-root extrapolation from 5%-scenario chance. From 5% to 20%, unchanged national vote share and absent new usable geographic evidence produce unchanged indicative scenario chance (~23.23%). Beyond 20%, with no geographic forecast, abstain.
liveProbabilityFix.productionStatus: Committed to engine.js and accompanying tests; normal Git/Vercel production deployment.

priorityRecommendations: Preserve current estimator as primary; run partial-municipality challenger silently in parallel and log its errors after outcome, rather than applying an unvalidated blend during the election.
Get precinct/zone-level first-round references and partially counted precinct coverage from TSE, instead of using only municipality average preference; focus capital and metro subregions.
Replay actual archived national, state and municipal snapshots in strictly chronological order, preserving what data was available at each point; do not backfill past predictions.
Assess 5-10% accuracy separately with nonrandom regional receipt and heterogeneity; report worst-case as well as pooled MAE.
Calibrate empirical win probabilities on independent election nights and report abstention rather than '99% guarantee' without a justified tail model.
